pos.personaBrief: Allegri preached control and patience with about 54% possession (Spielverlagerung 2016), but sat in a deep 4-4-2 block and relied on the defence against Bayern, so possession is a tool for safety rather than a goal.

pro.personaBrief: Juve passed out from deep even under pressure (Spielverlagerung), with Pirlo and Pjanic as builders. But Allegri also used long balls to Tevez and Morata against Dortmund and did not rush forward on recovery.

est.personaBrief: Organised, rehearsed phases with a back three or four and fixed double pivot, but flexible forwards (Dybala, Mandzukic) dropped between the lines and midfielders made inside runs. Structure with licence for the front players.

lar.personaBrief: Width came from wing-backs or full-backs (Alves, Sandro) while the diamond and the 4-2-3-1 packed the middle with technical midfielders. Wide wingers were not essential.

blo.personaBrief: The most common defensive shape was a compact 4-4-2 or 5-4-1 sitting deep with only intermittent waves of pressing. Forwards pressed to force play wide, but the team regrouped rather than counter-pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking with smaller man-orientations, a man-oriented zonal system he likes (Spielverlagerung). No dedicated shadowing of stars, and corner defending was area-based, though he complained about it.

pla.personaBrief: A manager without dogmas who changed shape by opponent and by mid-match (Coaches' Voice, Goal), adapting to the squad he found and to the opponent, and who set up to neutralise Bayern and Barcelona.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic: five consecutive titles, content to frustrate and defend for long spells, and happy to rely on the defence for 0-0 or 1-0 wins. The result is the aim.

sis.personaBrief: He reshaped the system around available talent and stars (Dybala, Higuain, Ronaldo) but demanded work from them, such as Mandzukic covering the flank. Everyone had a tactical role.

jog.personaBrief: A mix of technical regulators (Pirlo, Pjanic, Marchisio) and physical presences (Khedira, Mandzukic, the BBC). Quality on the ball matters for the deep playmaker, but intensity and duels are required.

bas.personaBrief: He leaned on proven players and the usato garantito (Goal 2017, Caceres) and left experienced players to it (FourFourTwo). The squad was built through signings, not the academy.

lid.personaBrief: A calm man-manager who praised his players, but he was firm: he left Bonucci out against Porto, and he decided the line-ups himself, which caused some grumbling in the dressing room.
